title: Swasthya Sathi – West Bengal Policy Document

nodes.title: 1. Overview & Objectives
nodes.content: West Bengal government health assurance scheme providing cashless hospitalization coverage to eligible families through empanelled hospitals.

nodes.title: 2. Eligibility Criteria
nodes.content: Eligibility is based on West Bengal's current scheme rules and beneficiary criteria; government employees covered by other schemes may be excluded or treated differently.

nodes.title: 3. Benefits & Coverage
nodes.content: Financial assistance and healthcare benefits provided under Swasthya Sathi – West Bengal.

nodes.title: 4. Required Documents & Application Process
nodes.content: Aadhaar Card, Income Certificate, Ration Card, and Bank Account details.
